title: Harbour Street Bridge rebuild status
brief: Whitcombe City's Public Works department wants a status page for the Harbour Street Bridge rebuild as of 2026-10-16, for the council and residents. Overall the project is 58 percent complete. Budget approved is 31.5 million dollars and 17.2 million has been spent (54.6 percent), including 1.3 million drawn from the 2.1 million contingency. Planned completion was 2027-09-30; the forecast is now 2027-11-15, which is 46 days late. The bridge is closed to vehicles; the detour adds about 7 minutes to a trip, and the footbridge stays open. Under "Milestones" show six milestones with percent complete and status: Old span demolition, 100, complete; Pier foundations, 100, complete; Steel girder fabrication, 85, amber; Girder erection, 30, amber; Approach roads and utilities, 40, green; Deck and parapets, 0, not started. Girder fabrication is amber because the steel supplier is 5 weeks behind. Under "Risks", two: the supplier delay, and winter concrete pours for the deck (heated enclosures are budgeted at 380000 dollars). Under "Next 30 days": the first girders are delivered on 2026-11-02, and a public information meeting is held on 2026-11-05 at 18:30 at the library. People will read this on their phones.

edit.request: The forecast completion moves to 2027-10-29 because a second fabricator was added, and steel girder fabrication is now 92 percent complete.
